ablation.name: phase4f_lvl4
ablation.notes: Phase 4F.2: 4-Level Haar DWT lowpass. Tests if the multi-level trend continues: lvl1→2 gave +0.0040 clip, lvl2→3 gave +0.0018 clip (diminishing returns). LL_4 (2x2) is near-global-average — risk of being too aggressive. If this gives +0.0009 clip (half of previous), the trend is logarithmic and worth documenting. If it FAILS, 3-Level is the sweet spot.
